main_attacks.wizard: Fire Bolt (+5 to hit, 1d10 fire damage) or Quarterstaff (+2 to hit, 1d6 bludgeoning)
main_attacks.rogue: Rapier (+5 to hit, 1d8+3 piercing, Sneak Attack +1d6)
main_attacks.cleric: Mace (+4 to hit, 1d6+2 bludgeoning) or Sacred Flame (DC 13 Dex, 1d8 radiant)
main_attacks.ranger: Longbow (+5 to hit, 1d8+3 piercing) or Shortswords (+5 to hit, 1d6+3 slashing)
main_attacks.paladin: Greatsword (+5 to hit, 2d6+3 slashing) or Divine Smite
main_attacks.bard: Rapier (+4 to hit, 1d8+2 piercing) or Vicious Mockery (DC 13 Wis, 1d4 psychic)
main_attacks.druid: Produce Flame (+4 to hit, 1d8 fire) or Scimitar (+3 to hit, 1d6+1 slashing)
main_attacks.warlock: Eldritch Blast (+5 to hit, 1d10 force damage)

background_equipment.acolyte: Prayer book, 5 sticks of incense, vestments, set of common clothes, 15 gp.
background_equipment.criminal: Crowbar, set of dark common clothes with hood, belt pouch, 15 gp.
background_equipment.folk_hero: Set of artisan's tools, shovel, iron pot, set of common clothes, belt pouch, 10 gp.
background_equipment.noble: Set of fine clothes, signet ring, scroll of pedigree, purse containing 25 gp.
background_equipment.sage: Ink bottle, quill, small knife, letter from a dead colleague, common clothes, pouch with 10 gp.
background_equipment.soldier: Insignia of rank, trophy from a fallen enemy, set of bone dice, common clothes, belt pouch, 10 gp.
background_equipment.urchin: Small knife, map of hometown, pet mouse, token from parents, common clothes, belt pouch, 10 gp.
background_equipment.outlander: Staff, hunting trap, trophy from an animal, set of traveler's clothes, belt pouch, 10 gp.

starting_equipment: [{class_name} Gear] Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days of rations, waterskin. [{background_name}] {background_equipment}

spells.wizard: Spellbook (Cantrips: Fire Bolt, Light, Mage Hand; 1st Level: Magic Missile, Shield, Sleep). Subclass ({subclass}): Feature unlocked.
spells.cleric: Divine Spellcasting (Cantrips: Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy, Guidance; 1st Level: Cure Wounds, Bless, Guiding Bolt). Domain ({subclass}).
spells.warlock: Pact Magic (Cantrips: Eldritch Blast, Minor Illusion; 1st Level: Hellish Rebuke, Hex). Patron ({subclass}).
spells.bard: Spellcasting (Cantrips: Vicious Mockery, Prestidigitation; 1st Level: Healing Word, Dissonant Whispers, Thunderwave). College ({subclass}).
spells.druid: Druidic Magic & Wild Shape (Cantrips: Druidcraft, Produce Flame; 1st Level: Entangle, Cure Wounds). Circle ({subclass}).
spells.ranger: Wilderness magic unlocks at Level 2. Specialized Focus ({subclass}). Racial Trait ({race}): Natural adaptability.
spells.paladin: Divine Smite & Lay on Hands (Aura of Protection). Oath ({subclass}). Racial Trait ({race}): Blessed resilience.
spells.fighter: Martial Superiority & Second Wind ({subclass}). No innate spellcasting unless Eldritch Knight (Cantrips: Blade Ward, Fire Bolt).
spells.rogue: Sneak Attack & Cunning Action ({subclass}). No innate spellcasting unless Arcane Trickster (Cantrips: Mage Hand, Minor Illusion).
